places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: At the corrals Wilbarger cuts out his horses and offers thirty-eight for Call's mare; Augustus arrives with the Irishmen, who find the dusty town a letdown.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; a few buildings, an adobe house with corrals and no trees; Jake goes off to the Dry Bean saloon

places.name: Sabinas
places.note: Augustus says he detoured there overnight with the Irishmen, visiting its brothel and taking saddles and nags from drunk bandits.
places.location_hint: in Mexico, within a night's ride of the Flores ranch and Lonesome Dove

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Call tells Augustus to move the stolen horses upriver; Pea recalls the Rangers once going up the river after bandits.

places.name: Brush Country
places.note: Call rides off northeast into it on his gelding Sunup to hire hands.
places.location_hint: south Texas scrub, northeast of Lonesome Dove

places.name: Rainey ranch
places.note: Call may go there to hire some of Maude Rainey's many sons; Augustus once courted Maude.
places.location_hint: somewhere in the brush country, apparently northeast of Lonesome Dove

places.name: Fort Phantom Hill
places.note: Pea was shot behind the shoulder blades in a big Indian fight near there.

places.name: Chihuahua
places.note: Years ago the Rangers went upriver chasing bandits who raided out of it, around the time Newt was born.

places.name: Pickles Gap
places.note: Joe Cole was buying a milk cow there when lightning killed him and his horse.
places.location_hint: small settlement in the south Texas brush near Lonesome Dove

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Dish doubted Irishmen could be found down there; Sean had not expected Mexico to be green.

places.name: Veracruz
places.note: The Irish brothers were put ashore there after a long homesick voyage.

places.raw_name: the green land he had left
places.name: Ireland
places.note: Sean pines for the green, cool, grassy home he left behind.

places.name: Boston
places.note: A magazine picture of its snowy winter harbor shaped Sean's idea of America.

places.name: United States
places.note: Sean is disappointed that America is hot sand and thornbrush, with no snow.

places.name: Matagorda
places.note: Dish grew up there and boasts of its knee-high grass.
places.location_hint: Texas Gulf Coast around Matagorda Bay

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call says the outfit is driving there; Wilbarger warns it is too far, cold, bear-ridden and maybe Indian-held.

places.name: Wilbarger's herd camp
places.note: Wilbarger and Chick leave for it with the recovered horses; he is about to trail three thousand head north.
places.location_hint: beyond the Nueces River from Lonesome Dove

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: at the Hat Creek house after breakfast; Augustus is to move the horse herd upriver that afternoon

groups.label: Call
groups.hint: riding northeast from Lonesome Dove to hire hands, possibly at the Raineys'

groups.label: O'Brien brothers
groups.hint: eating breakfast at the Hat Creek house

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: went straight to the Dry Bean saloon

groups.label: Wilbarger's party
groups.hint: riding home from Lonesome Dove with their recovered horses
